## Problem and change

Describe the observed problem and what this change does. Link an issue if one exists.

## Validation

Record the tests run and their results. State whether any live AI calls were made.

## Review

- [ ] The change matches the stated scope.
- [ ] Relevant automated tests pass.
- [ ] New behavior is documented where needed.
- [ ] Credentials and private data are absent from the diff.
- [ ] Model claims are checked against evidence when applicable.
